```python
import re

def solve(env, goal):
    # Parse goal: "put a clean <object> in <target>"
    m = re.search(r"put a clean (.*?) in (\S+)\.?", goal, re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r"put a clean (.*?) in (\S+)", goal, re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        return
    obj_name = m.group(1).strip()
    target_name = m.group(2)

    # Initial observation is the room description
    obs = env.observation

    # Extract all listed items with their numbers
    items = re.findall(r"a ([a-zA-Z_]+) ([0-9]+)", obs)
    if not items:
        items = re.findall(r"a ([a-zA-Z_]+)", obs)
        items = [(name, '') for name in items]

    # Locate target receptacle and sinkbasin
    target_item = None
    sink_item = None
    for name, num in items:
        full = f"{name} {num}" if num else name
        if name == target_name:
            target_item = full
        if name == "sinkbasin":
            sink_item = full

    if target_item is None or sink_item is None:
        return

    # Search for the object by exploring each listed item/container
    object_found = False
    full_obj = None
    found_location = None

    for name, num in items:
        loc = f"{name} {num}" if num else name
        env.step(f"go to {loc}")

        # Try to open closed containers to reveal their contents
        if f"open {loc}" in env.admissible():
            env.step(f"open {loc}")
            env.step(f"look")

        obs = env.observation
        m_obj = re.search(r"a " + re.escape(obj_name) + r" ([0-9]+)", obs)
        if m_obj:
            full_obj = f"{obj_name} {m_obj.group(1)}"
            object_found = True
            found_location = loc
            break

    if not object_found:
        return

    # Take the object from its location
    env.step(f"take {full_obj} from {found_location}")

    # Clean it with the sinkbasin
    env.step(f"go to {sink_item}")
    env.step(f"clean {full_obj} with {sink_item}")

    # Move it to the target receptacle
    env.step(f"go to {target_item}")
    env.step(f"move {full_obj} to {target_item}")
```
